pass1.sentence: A coronary angiogram is an X-ray of the coronary arteries, the blood vessels that supply the heart muscle.
pass1.note: Summary: X-ray of coronary arteries; arteries don't show on ordinary X-rays; helps doctor spot narrowed areas or blockages; information about structure of heart and how well it works; also called cardiac catheterisation.
